copy.linkedin:
1,313 tests passed and the game had no buttons

On Thursday a first-time player sat down, the game drew its art and a doom percentage, and offered nothing to click. 1,313 tests were green. The cause is a per-checkout cache that CI can never see go stale, because CI always starts clean. The guard shipped Friday afternoon; the identical failure shape was back within hours - and this time it was caught.
